_source: Captured off the wire at 19:00:06 on 2026-08-08, when imreeyal's thief pushed the sub-game 1 agreement to our /cop/mcp. FastMCP refused it with unexpected_keyword_argument loc=('message',) before any handler ran, so the message reached our log intact without ever reaching our code. This is a real reference-v3 greeting, not a hand-written one.
_redacted: identity.members and identity.spec are dropped. They are another team's personal names and their machine's hardware profile, neither of which any assertion here needs, and this repository is public. Everything load-bearing for the handshake is kept verbatim.
